# Database Adapter Class Instructions

## Purpose
Provide persistence operations behind domain ports; map raw rows → domain entities; enforce soft-delete & consistency.

## Artifacts
- `<root>.adapter.ts`
- `__test__/adapter-entity/mock-<root>.adapter-entity.ts`.

## Naming
- Class: `PostgresSql<Root>PortAdapter`
- Adapter Entity Type: `T<Root>AdapterEntity`

## Structure
```ts
export type T<Entity>AdapterEntity = typeof <entity>Table.$inferSelect & {
  // add relations here if needed
  // <relatedEntity>: T<RelatedEntity>AdapterEntity;
  // <relatedEntity>List: T<RelatedEntity>AdapterEntity[];

};

export class PostgresSql<Root>PortAdapter implements I<Root>Port {
  constructor(private readonly logger: TLoggerPort) {
    this.db = drizzle(DB_CLIENT, { schema: DB_SCHEMA, logger: new DrizzleLogger(logger.child({ adapter: 'PostgresSql<Root>PortAdapter' })) });
  }

  public static toDomainEntity(row: T<Root>AdapterEntity): T<Root>Entity {
    return {
      /* field mapping + optional relation recursion */

      // map relations if loaded
      ...(entity.<relatedEntity> && {
        <relatedEntity>: PostgresSql<Entity>PortAdapter.toDomainEntity(entity.<relatedEntity>),
      }),
    } satisfies T<Root>Entity;
  }

  async findByUUID(uuid: TUUID): Promise<T<Root>Entity | null> {
    const row = await this.db.query.<ENTITY>.findFirst({
      where: (f, { eq, and }) => and(eq(f.uuid, uuid), eq(f.status, true)),
      with: { /* relations if preloading */ },
    });
    return row ? PostgresSql<Root>PortAdapter.toDomain(row) : null;
  }
}
```

## Implementation Rules
| Concern | Rule |
|---------|------|
| Soft Delete | All reads filter `status = true` |
| Transactions | Wrap multi-step writes: `this.db.transaction(tx => { ... })` |
| Logging | Log errors with code/detail then throw domain error |
| Mapping | Only via static `toDomain` function |
| Batching | Provide batch create/update when use case needs it |

## Error Handling
- Catch DB-specific errors (constraint violation) → translate to domain error (e.g., conflict)
- Do not leak driver error objects upwards

## Performance
- Preload required relations in single query (avoid N+1)
- Use explicit column selection if row size large

## Anti-Patterns
- Returning DTOs
- Business rules inside adapter
- Silent catch blocks

## Quality Gates
- No `any`
- Only public methods required by port interface
- Codacy scan after edits
